reviews.text:
My groomer for 15 years
A true artist with my dogs
€80 for a bubble bath and detangling. My cat was traumatized by the experience; it's not worth the price at all. Avoid at all costs.
Terrible! My cat was terrified and traumatized by the experience. €80 for a bubble bath and detangling. AVOID AT ALL COSTS!

Very pleasant service. I had called a few days before because our cat had knots under its paws. The price was clear and it took 10 minutes. He explained why it happened and how to prevent it from happening again. Great, thank you!

A very mixed experience. The groomer was extremely blasé from the moment I arrived. I should mention that my dog ​​is stressed and has never had her nails trimmed before. I could see him pulling at her, clearly annoyed that she was pulling her paw away. And he judged my dog, who is in the middle of shedding, by looking up at her, even though we could see you, sir! And you don't know why she's in that state. A little kindness and compassion towards animals, I believe, is the principle of your profession.
She was even limping when we left, so a gentler touch would have been appreciated. And the little lady who told me, "Pugs are usually gentle, it's strange," SHE IS VERY NICE. Just stressed because she was taken into a room where all the dogs were barking and whining! The nail trim was okay, though. Thank you anyway.

I entrusted my Persian mix cat to a groomer on May 30th, as I was delighted with the service the previous year: a disaster! He came out bald on one side, his skin was bright red, and he jumped at the slightest touch. Unacceptable, and they charged me €80 (for a massacre!). I will never trust them again; my cat is the apple of my eye, and I am absolutely furious.

I am deeply shocked by this grooming salon. I had an appointment for my cat on April 25th. From the moment I booked, there was a mistake with the day and time (which can happen).

On the day, I dropped off my cat at 10:00 AM. I was told they would call me back around 12:00 or 12:30 PM. At 12:45 PM, having heard nothing, I went to the salon. They then explained, with little consideration, that my cat hadn't cooperated and that they hadn't done anything. They added that he had urinated on himself and had been put back in his carrier in that state.

So I picked up my stressed cat, partially shaved, and with a strong odor of urine. No one called me to inform me or offer a solution.

I was then asked to come back at 5:00 PM, before being called back only to be canceled due to lack of time.

I understand that you shouldn't force an animal, but the least they could have done was warn me immediately. Leaving a cat in its bag in that state for hours is unacceptable.

A very disappointing experience. I won't be back.

Very satisfied with my experience.
I took my 9-month-old dachshund there for his very first grooming session and a scissor cut.
I'm absolutely delighted with the result, thank you again 🙏🏼
After two bad experiences, this was my first time at Canicoiff for my two Yorkies. I'm so happy! Impeccable haircuts. They're so cute. And the owner is lovely. I recommend them 200%!

Thank you for your trust.
We look forward to seeing you again.

The Management
Excellent work, impeccable hair removal according to breed standards

We have a very beautiful Standard Poodle and although we live in Annecy, we were told by someone who has a small poodle that Rachid at Canicoiff and his team were very very good. She was not wrong!! I have had my poodle groomed all over the world (Los Angeles, Washington DC, Croatia, Italy, and now France)--The team here is wonderful--they respected my wish to leave my girl's long eyelashes, they took care of her ears as asked, and they gave her a STUNNING cut--She is so beautiful--absolutely world class grooming--MERCI MERCI!!! We will be back!

First experience and I'd go back. Two huskies. Quick availability (3 days) and a small discount because I brought both my dogs at the same time. They didn't have their nails trimmed, but the most important thing was the shampooing and brushing.

I don't recommend this place for taking a cat. €80 for a dry grooming when they told me they were going to bathe my cat. I find that outrageous! And that's so much fur to remove when we get home!
It might be fine for taking a dog, but avoid it for a cat. It's a shame because very few groomers in Lyon accept cats.
Beautiful haircut, a warmer welcome would have been perfect
First grooming session for my little Aïly (Pomeranian Spitz)! Thank you to Rachid for his warm welcome and invaluable advice! So glad I found this salon, I highly recommend it! 👌 …

Excellent service at the salon.
Kindness, advice, and professionalism were all present.

I highly recommend the salon!!!
My cats look beautiful and are well-groomed.

Thank you to the team of young women.

And thank you to the manager who gave me great advice and a very warm welcome.

Sincerely,
Sylvie P. 🙂😀
🙂🙂

I think we really got the wrong person, judging by the other reviews… But her demeanor was catastrophic.

I don't know if we got a new employee, an intern, or something like that, but if you don't like animals, you don't choose a job like this.
We arrived, and she didn't even give our dog a pat or a little attention. During the haircut, as soon as the phone rang, she ran to answer it without even apologizing. Luckily, I stayed with my dog, otherwise he would have just tried to jump off the table and hurt himself…
Of course, I'm not even going to mention the state of the haircut; having to pay €70 for that is just outrageous. When I got home, I noticed that some parts hadn't even been cut; I had to do it myself.
In the end, the person supervising her didn't even bother to check the apprentice's work (even though the apprentice had been asking questions the whole time, asking if her method was correct).
I won't be going back there, and I hope no one else has to deal with this "new" staff. Truly very disappointing.

Thank you again for grooming my Yorkshire dog Lady, a salon I have been going to for years and wouldn't change for anything in the world, super meticulous work, and kind to animals, lovely salon and pleasant staff.

Actually, I'm not giving any stars. I made an appointment by phone, explaining that I have a 10 kg Maine Coon mix cat with large mats... According to Canicoiff', there were no problems, great for my cat! He'd already been to the groomer.

I brought my cat to the appointment, but half an hour later, there was a problem... "Come get your cat because I'm alone and can't handle him as he's attacking..." I had trouble removing the ball from his mouth that I'd put there to prevent him from biting me. It doesn't seem right for a groomer to act like that. Furthermore, when I picked up my ungroomed cat, they asked me for €10 because they had trimmed his claws... great! They asked me when I wanted to make an appointment for when there would be two of them... NO THANKS. I think that given all the information I provided, they could have planned for two people.
Fantastic! Leo looks adorable and smells amazing! Thank you so much!
Amazing service!
Great haircut, friendly service. I recommend it.

Thanks again to the team for this last-minute appointment, which they accepted just an hour before. It was my dog's (Shih Tzu) first grooming session, and I'm absolutely thrilled! They transformed him into a little teddy bear at a very reasonable price 👍🏼 Thanks again, I'll definitely be back! 😉 …

I am extremely satisfied with the service at Canicoiff' grooming salon! My Golden Retriever was beautifully groomed, with an impeccable and meticulous cut. The work is truly well done, and you can feel the professionalism and passion of the team. The welcome was warm and attentive, which immediately put me at ease. I highly recommend this salon and will not hesitate to return. Thank you again for your excellent service!

A grooming appointment that turned into a nightmare. I took him in for a €65 grooming session, and my poor dog was in a terrible state, with very deep cuts, one of which became infected. My dog ​​will never set foot in that torture chamber again!!! Avoid at all costs!!!

New Canicoiff salon in the 7th arrondissement.
Always very professional.
So happy to have a salon near me.
I thank this grooming salon for the warm welcome; the staff were very pleasant and smiling. I'm happy to have such a good groomer in Lyon's 7th arrondissement. See you soon!
